integrity: Analytic proofs are presented with finite exact combinatorial consistency tests; independent external audit is unperformed.
scientific_limitations: The stationary selection law refers to the exactly solvable unperturbed invariant core and a product of an invariant one-dimensional law, not ambient basin volumes.
The entropy and exponent formula requires an ergodic absolutely continuous invariant measure of the expanding cyclic interval map.
The cycle-count numerator follows from standard Möbius inversion applied to source fixed-point counts; the additional metric component comparison is the substantive extension.
The result does not assert independence, validation, or uniqueness for arbitrary nonlinear perturbations.
title: Component-size spectrum and entropy rigidity in cyclic skew-tent products
